[SWS_CRYPT_40947]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::IOInterface::
GetAllowedUsage
shall return the allowed usage flags of the underlying CryptoOb-
ject this IOInterface points to. If the content that the IOInterface points to is empty,
kAllowPrototypedOnly
shall be returned.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02004)
